decisions.reason: After another year, the combined robot looks like the firm's preferred integrated automation offer, and its strategic fit and likely low carrying cost make it worth keeping.
The stand-alone de-shuttering robot now faces clearer overlap with the combined system, but it still keeps open a stepwise-automation option for customers not ready for the full solution.
This storage robot is more niche and by 2025 its market potential should be clearer, yet as a complementary module in automated plants it is still reasonable to keep on the market.
As a 2024 product line with several models in the firm's core equipment range, uncertainty is still high and the option value of keeping it open remains strong.
The software deepens the firm's integrated equipment-and-service offering and supports the future automation roadmap, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it this early.
